title: Iran Releases 'Proof of Life' Video of Supreme Leader Amid Critical-Health Reports
detail: Iran's semi-official Mehr News Agency released a brief, undated video of Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei meeting advisers, his first public appearance footage since succeeding his father in March 2026. The release came after Israeli media reported Khamenei was in 'extremely critical condition' and followed months without any public sighting since he was reportedly badly injured in the February 28 strike that killed his father. President Masoud Pezeshkian acknowledged in a broadcast interview that communication with Khamenei is currently 'very difficult,' while Donald Trump claimed the Iranian leader was '90 percent gone.' The video's lack of date or location stamp fueled further questions about its authenticity and timing rather than resolving them.

media.caption: Iran releases rare video of Mojtaba Khamenei amid reports of deteriorating health

confidenceReason: Video authenticity, date, and location are unconfirmed; officials in Tehran and Washington offer conflicting characterizations of Khamenei's condition.

title: Officials Warn Naval Blockade Is Pushing Iran's Economy Toward Collapse
detail: Iranian regime moderates and economists warned the US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz is bringing the economy 'close to collapse,' with no tankers loaded at Kharg Island — which normally handles roughly 90% of Iran's oil exports — for at least a week. Reported figures showed annual inflation at 88.6%, unemployment at 9.1%, and GDP contracting an estimated 5.4% for the year. Iran's deputy foreign minister said sanctions relief through a US deal is 'desperately needed,' even as Tehran maintains maximalist demands — lifting the blockade, withdrawing forces, and ending the war — before fully reopening the strait.

media.caption: Officials warn Iran's economy is nearing collapse under the naval blockade

confidenceReason: Figures and quotes reported by Fortune citing Wall Street Journal sourcing and Iranian officials; not yet independently verified against IMF/Statistical Centre of Iran releases.
